avoid_supplements.name: Anticholinergic supplements (e.g., Jimson weed, Datura)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects may increase risk of urinary retention, constipation, confusion, and hallucinations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on anticholinergic side effects

avoid_supplements.name: Stimulant supplements (e.g., ephedra, excessive caffeine >300mg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined dopaminergic/stimulant activity may cause tachycardia, tremor, agitation, and cardiac arrhythmias
avoid_supplements.action: Limit caffeine intake and avoid herbal stimulants; monitor heart rate and blood pressure

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild dopaminergic effects; potential for additive CNS stimulation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased tremor, insomnia, or agitation

caution_supplements.name: L-DOPA supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Combined dopaminergic activity may enhance therapeutic or adverse effects
caution_supplements.action: Use together cautiously; monitor for dyskinesia or behavioral changes

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods (processed foods, cured meats)
caution_foods.mechanism: Amantadine is renally eliminated; excessive sodium may affect fluid/electrolyte balance and renal function monitoring
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate sodium intake; maintain consistent hydration status

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-rich beverages (coffee, energy drinks, tea)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may potentiate CNS stimulation and increase amantadine-related tremor or insomnia
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate amounts (<300mg/day); monitor for CNS overstimulation

monitoring_notes: Amantadine has minimal drug metabolism but is renally eliminated; monitor renal function regularly, especially in elderly patients or those with renal impairment. Watch for CNS effects (tremor, insomnia, hallucinations) and anticholinergic symptoms (urinary retention, constipation), which may be exacerbated by supplements or high caffeine intake.
